keyFacts.title: City of Hektor
keyFacts.description: Born on the race track, living in the city. Hektor is the only track bike with Gates Belt Drive—engineered for race-grade performance while at the same time being suitable for daily use. The incredibly stiff frame as well as the specific geometry provides the most direct and agile riding experience of all Schindelhauer bikes. Hektor is available in two variants: fixed or freewheel with brakes.
